investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Ironpine Cloud (collaboration SaaS); Platform: on-premises data center DC-Central, server range 10.184.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster ironpi-prod (kubeadm); Database: members-db-01 holds members records; Automation: data-retention workflows scheduled by Dagster and executed under service accounts (runs recorded with RUN- identifiers); Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
